'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Unknown Player LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Unknown Player]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

Name blank on the Day 1 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Communing (Virtual Block 7)|Communing]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
